page_title: The Best AI Girlfriend Generator - DreamGF.ai

sources.entry: DreamGF - DreamGF uses AI algorithms to generate virtual partners according to user preferences. Users can customize the appearance, personality, and other traits. #freemium

summary.name: DreamGF
summary.one_liner: DreamGF.ai is a web platform for building a custom AI girlfriend character by choosing appearance and personality, then chatting, roleplaying, and receiving generated images.
use_cases: create a custom virtual girlfriend character
generate images of an AI character
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a builder where users mix and match face, body, and clothing features and choose a personality for their AI girlfriend. Users can generate more content on the character's profile page and chat with the character, which the page describes as roleplay and sexting. The site lists photos on demand and voice messages as features. A daily claim bonus gives 10 free messages on day one, rising by one per day up to 50 on day 40, with the streak resetting to 10 if a day is missed. Account creation is free, and paid plans unlock more content and messages.
notable: Mix-and-match builder for AI girlfriend appearance and personality
Daily claim bonus starting at 10 messages and growing up to 50 over 40 days
Sign-in with Google or email password
caveats: Paid plans auto-renew, priced at $12.99 first month then $25.98 monthly, or $44.28 first year then $88.56 annually; promotions can change prices
Referral rewards are for premium users only and the referral offer is time-limited
Free accounts can look around, but more content and messages require an upgrade
